release_notes: Adds an Assistant panel: ask about the model in English, review it for duplicate faces, slivers and open edges, and search the 1,586-material library by description. The render dialog gains a Describe the lighting box, and overcast is now a real setting rather than haze. The review, the material search and the lighting briefs need no AI service at all. Runs against Anthropic or a local Ollama, chosen in Preferences; editing is off by default. The tool rail can now be dragged to any edge by its grip.
